Kite String Length, heights and distances, Class 10 board exam: a kite flies 60 m high and its string makes 60° with the ground. Find the length of the string.

• Draw it: height AB = 60 m, string AC = L is the hypotenuse
• sin 60° = AB/AC = 60/L
• √3/2 = 60/L, so L = 120/√3
• Rationalise: L = 120√3/3 = 40√3 m ≈ 69.28 m
